measurement_clause_text: Payment is based on accepted removed surface; field quantity documentation must distinguish actual panel surface from vendor schedule quantities.
Payment is based on accepted installed panel surface; field quantity documentation must distinguish fabricated panel surface from vendor schedule quantities.
Payment is based on accepted finished surface; field quantity documentation must distinguish plan surface from vendor schedule quantities.
Payment is based on accepted installed length; field quantity documentation must distinguish geometric skew length from vendor schedule quantities.
Payment is based on accepted repaired zone; field quantity documentation must distinguish each verified bearing zone from vendor schedule quantities.
Payment is based on accepted treated area; field quantity documentation must distinguish mapped steel loss area from vendor schedule quantities.
Payment is based on DFT-passing surface; field quantity documentation must distinguish accepted coated surface from vendor schedule quantities.
Payment is based on installed functional assembly; field quantity documentation must distinguish each accepted assembly from vendor schedule quantities.
Payment is based on accepted contract basis; field quantity documentation must distinguish lump sum from vendor schedule quantities.
Payment is based on accepted stage plan; field quantity documentation must distinguish approved stage/window from vendor schedule quantities.
Payment is based on accepted compliance scope; field quantity documentation must distinguish approved containment scope from vendor schedule quantities.
Payment is based on board-approved risk basis; field quantity documentation must distinguish identified residual risk from vendor schedule quantities.
